title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Simpson looks like he is nearly full health again. He was a full participant in Thursday's practice after being limited by a nagging groin issue on Wednesday. He should be a full go for Week 3, which is good news for the Ravens' offense as a whole.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) upgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson (finger) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran edge rusher was a non-participant at the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday, but he was back on Thursday and officially practiced in a limited capacity. He should be able to play through his injury again in Week 3, assuming he doesn't reaggravate it between now and then.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Moore (ankle) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Chris Moore (ankle) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Baltimore is dealing with multiple injuries in their wide receiver room right now, including Moore, who has been limited at both practices so far this week due to an ankle injury. He seems more likely than not to play in Week 3, however, and would be in line for more work than usual if Zay Flowers (hamstring) is ruled out against the Cowboys.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Quinshon Judkins (personal) limited at practice on Thursday
items.desc: Quinshon Judkins (personal) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The young running back was a limited participant at practice on Thursday due to a personal issue of some kind. It doesn't seem likely to threaten his availability for Sunday's game, but we won't know more for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tytus Howard (knee) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Tytus Howard (knee) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was able to practice in full on Thursday after being limited by a knee injury on Wednesday, which is a good indication that he will be available to play this week. His presence will be big for Cleveland ahead of a matchup against the Panthers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyson Campbell (ankle/hip) limited Thursday
items.desc: Tyson Campbell (ankle/hip) was limited at Cleveland's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Campbell was a limited participant for a second-straight practice on Thursday due to a couple of different injuries. It could threaten his availability for Sunday's game, but we should know more about his status after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tony Pollard (ankle) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Tony Pollard (ankle) returned to practice for the Titans on Thursday.
items.impact: Pollard was seen participating in the open portion of Tennessee's practice on Thursday. That's a step in the right direction for his availability for Week 3, and he could be the team's clear-cut workhorse this week if Tyjae Spears (ankle) has to miss time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (ankle) not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (ankle) was not seen at practice for the Titans on Thursday.
items.impact: Spears was not spotted at Thursday's practice after being sidelined on Wednesday due to ankle soreness. It seems to be a day-to-day issue for him, but fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health over the next day or two, as Tony Pollard (ankle) will see a rise in fantasy value if he's Tennessee's clear-cut RB1 against the Giants.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) plans to play Sunday
items.desc: Chris Bell (knee) told reporters that he plans to play in Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: The rookie is dealing with a knee issue right now, but it's not considered a serious issue, and he told reporters that he is planning to play through it against the Chiefs. It remains to be seen if he will carry an injury designation heading into the weekend, but it looks highly likely that the team will clear him to play sooner rather than later.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) was seen at Minnesota's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was spotted during the open portion of Minnesota's practice on Thursday after being sidelined on Wednesday due to a minor knee issue. That's a good sign, but we won't know more about his status until the team's official injury report comes out after practice on Thursday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darren Waller (rest) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Darren Waller (rest) returned to practice and was a full participant on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, the veteran was back at practice on Thursday after getting the day off on Wednesday as a veteran rest day. He should be a full go for Week 3 and will continue to have touchdown upside on a week-to-week basis moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Devin Lloyd (calf) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Devin Lloyd (calf) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran linebacker has been out for two-straight practices to start the week. His calf injury seems to be a real problem for him and could leave him sidelined against the Browns this week. If that's the case, Carolina's defense will be weaker than usual due to his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Patrick Jones II (back) a full participant Thursday
items.desc: Patrick Jones II (back) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jones seems to be on the right track for Week 3, as he has been a full participant at practice all week despite still dealing with a nagging back issue. He should be good to go for Sunday's game, but we that won't be official until sometime in the coming days.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bobby Brown III (back) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Bobby Brown III (back) practiced in full again on Thursday.
items.impact: The big man was able to practice in a full capacity for a second-straight day on Thursday. It looks like he is going to be back in the lineup in Week 3, which will be a welcomed boost for Carolina's defensive front.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (back) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Jaelan Phillips (back) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Phillips returned to practice and was able to log a full session on Thursday after being absent on Wednesday due to a back issue. He should be good to go for Week 3, which is good news for Carolina's defense ahead of a favorable matchup against the Browns.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Xavier Legette (knee) missed Carolina's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Legette was a non-participant on Wednesday. He's dealing with a knee injury right now and was held out because of that. It remains to be seen if it will affect his availability for Sunday's game, but we should know more after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Coker (ankle) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Jalen Coker (ankle) didn't take part in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Coker was held out of Thursday's practice due to his ankle injury that has been bothering him for a while. He was able to practice on Wednesday, though, so it seems like this may just be an injury management move from the part of the team. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his status over the next 24 hours or so.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) participating at practice Thursday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (knee) was seen participating at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Bowers was once again seen participating at Las Vegas' practice on Thursday. He has yet to play this season after undergoing a minor knee procedure before the season opener, but he has been progressing well by all accounts and seems likely to play in Week 3, although it remains to be seen whether or not he will have a major pitch count or not.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Malik Nabers (shoulder) seen practicing Thursday
items.desc: Malik Nabers (shoulder) was seen practicing for the Giants on Thursday.
items.impact: Nabers is at practice and was seen participating on Thursday. He recently suffered a shoulder injury, but it looks like he is going to be able to play through it in Week 3, barring any setbacks between now and then. Fantasy managers should keep tabs on his status throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keon Coleman (ankle) not seen practicing Thursday
items.desc: Keon Coleman (ankle) was not seen at practice for the Bills on Thursday.
items.impact: Coleman was not spotted at the start of Buffalo's practice on Thursday. He was a non-participant on Wednesday, so it looks like he may be trending that way again today. A second-straight absence would make him more likely than not to be sidelined this week, though he won't get an official injury designation until after Friday's practice.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) not spotted at practice Thursday
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) was not spotted at Buffalo's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout was not spotted during the portion of Thursday's practice that is open to the media. That doesn't mean that he will be a non-participant, but we won't know his status for sure until after practice. Look for Keon Coleman (ankle) and Khalil Shakir to see more work if Moore has to miss this week's game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ed Oliver (hip) at practice Thursday
items.desc: Ed Oliver returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Oliver missed practice on Wednesday to begin the week. His status will be worth monitoring on Thursday's injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bucky Irving on 'pitch count' for season per OC Zac Robinson
items.desc: Buccaneers OC Zac Robinson said RB Bucky Irving is on a bit of a pitch count due to the longevity of the season.
items.impact: Robinson added he also wants to go with the hot hand in-game. There was some thought going into the season that Kenneth Gainwell could play a bigger role than he has after he got paid in free agency, but Irving has been the clear lead back for Tampa Bay through the first two weeks of the season. This will remain a situation to monitor in the coming weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield (illness) says he practiced in full Thursday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield told reporters he practiced in full again on Thursday.
items.impact: Mayfield said he is feeling better as he battles an illness. He should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brian Burns (ankle) not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Brian Burns was not seen at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Burns is expected to miss some time with an ankle sprain. It is unclear if he has a chance to be placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Thomas (ankle) not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas was not seen at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: This will be something to monitor after Thomas practiced fully on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Caleb Douglas was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Douglas also missed practice on Wednesday. He is trending towards being sidelined this weekend against the Chiefs.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Teven Jenkins (back) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Teven Jenkins did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jenkins missed a second straight practice to begin the week. He'll likely need to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play this weekend.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (toe) remains absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley did not practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Stanley did not practice on Wednesday either. He'll likely need to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play on Sunday against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Zay Flowers remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Flowers continues to trend towards missing a second straight game. His status will need to be monitored on Friday to make sure.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Saquon Barkley (stinger) without update per HC Nick Sirianni
items.desc: Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni did not have an update on the status of Saquon Barkley on Thursday.
items.impact: The Eagles injury report will be released later in the afternoon. Tank Bigsby is worth stashing for now for fantasy managers just in case with Barkley.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Ramsey (rest) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Jalen Ramsey was back practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Ramsey was back after getting a rest day at practice to begin the week on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jamel Dean (ankle) back at practice Thursday
items.desc: Jamel Dean returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Dean opened the week missing practice on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored in practice again on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. practices Thursday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. logged a second straight practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Porter is continuing to work on getting his conditioning back. He could be on the field for the Steelers on Sunday with another practice on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Rico Dowdle did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Dowdle was seen in a boot during practice on Wednesday. He is likely to be ruled out this week. Jaylen Warren should enter Sunday's game in a clear lead role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Warren (shoulder) practices Thursday
items.desc: Jaylen Warren was in uniform and participating in the period open to the media on Thursday.
items.impact: Rico Dowdle missed another practice. Warren is trending towards being the clear lead back on Sunday against the Bengals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Frankie Luvu (groin) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Frankie Luvu was not seen at the start of practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Luvu is trending towards remaining sidelined for the Commanders on Sunday unless he can return to practice in some capacity on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo was not seen at the start of practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Okonkwo continues to work his way back from a hamstring injury. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to return on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Cosmi (concussion) not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Sam Cosmi was not seen at the start of practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Cosmi remains on track to be sidelined this weekend after being placed in concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent Brown (knee/wrist) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Trent Brown was back practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Brown missed practice on Wednesday to begin the week. His return on Thursday puts him on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadeveon Clowney (knee) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Jadeveon Clowney did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Clowney missed a second straight practice to begin the week. He'll likely need to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a good chance of playing on Sunday against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ed Ingram (groin) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Ed Ingram did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It is a second straight absence from practice for Ingram to begin the week. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Nico Collins remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Collins continues to trend towards missing a second straight game due to a hamstring injury. His status will still need to be monitored on Friday to end the practice week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Branson Combs not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Jaguars LB Branson Combs was not seen at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Combs was not on the injury report on Wednesday. His status will need to be monitored when Thursday's injury report is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dalton Schultz (rest) back at practice Thursday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: After a huge performance on Sunday, Schultz received a rest day to begin the practice week. If Nico Collins remains sidelined, he'll be in line for TE1 volume once again.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Javon Kinlaw (shoulder) practices Thursday
items.desc: Commanders DL Javon Kinlaw was practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Kinlaw is managing a shoulder injury. He'll have a chance to be good to go for a depleted Commanders defense with another practice on Friday.
